centralauth-groupname: The name of group name in CentralAuth.
miraheze-console-message:
Message logged to the browser console pointing users experiencing Content Security Policy (CSP) errors to a help page. Parameters:
* $1 - URL of the help page about Content Security Policy.
miraheze-csp-notification:
Message displayed in a notification when a Content Security Policy (CSP) violation is detected. Parameters:
* $1 - URL of the help page about Content Security Policy.
* $2 - List of URIs that were blocked by the policy.
miraheze-csp-notification-truncate: Truncation notice showing number of truncated URIs

miraheze-sitenotice-closed-private: Message to be displayed in site notice when a private wiki is marked as closed. "Closed" refers to {{msg-mw|Managewiki-label-closed}}.
miraheze-sitenotice-closed: Message to be displayed in site notice when a public wiki is marked as closed. "Closed" refers to {{msg-mw|Managewiki-label-closed}}.
miraheze-sitenotice-inactive-private: Message to be displayed in site notice when a private wiki is marked as inactive. "Closed" refers to {{msg-mw|Managewiki-label-closed}}. "Inactive" refers to {{msg-mw|Managewiki-label-inactive}}.
miraheze-sitenotice-inactive: Message to be displayed in site notice when a public wiki is marked as inactive.
miraheze-warnmessage: Message to be displayed in site notice when a public wiki is inactive.
